# The Holdfast

*A conger eel so vast its body runs through three decks of the Saltgrace, and it has never let go of her. It strikes from the hatches, holes and stern windows round the Captain's Cabin; watch for the water bulging and the portholes glowing. Its strength meets yours, whatever your level. Potions work in the cabin; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [The Holdfast](../monsters/holdfast.md) |
| Arena | [The Captain's Cabin](../maps/saltgrace_cabin.md) |
